meta.description: Talk to data APIs in plain English with Raynard.

hero.eyebrow: Open source desktop app for macOS, Linux, and Windows
hero.title: The AI agent that connects to any data source, public or private, and always cites its sources
hero.body: Raynard is an AI agent for data, not code—it turns a plain-English question into API calls across your sources and answers with a citation for every number.

linux.name: Linux
linux.label: Install on Linux
linux.spec: AppImage, Debian package, or one-line installer

hero.demoLabel: Product demo — live market data, cited

cards.title: Cited answers
cards.body: Every number in an answer links back to the API response it came from.

cards.title: Connect anything
cards.body: Give it a link to an API’s docs and it writes, tests, and calls the integration itself.

cards.title: Real numbers
cards.body: Figures come from the API’s response, not the model’s memory.

cards.title: Native desktop app
cards.body: Runs on macOS, Linux, and Windows. Conversations and credentials stay on your machine.

items.title: One question, three sources
items.prompt: Polymarket’s odds on the next Fed rate cut, what X is saying about it, and how the big banks have moved.
items.body: Three extensions, one answer. Each number keeps the source it came from.
bullets: The agent picks which tools to call
Cards render each source’s own data
items.mediaLabel: A Raynard answer combining Fed-rate-cut evidence from Polymarket, X, and Financial Modeling Prep

items.title: No invented numbers
items.prompt: How expensive is Nvidia on P/E, EV/EBITDA, and free-cash-flow yield?
items.body: Real figures from Financial Modeling Prep, each linked to the record behind it.
bullets: The source data stays with the answer
Send the whole thing as a link
items.mediaLabel: A cited Nvidia valuation answer in Raynard

items.title: Answers on your schedule
items.prompt: Check Polymarket for the market “Will Salesforce (CRM) beat quarterly earnings?” and report whether its implied probability is below 90% or above 95%.
items.body: Set the schedule once. Raynard runs the check automatically and leaves the result waiting in your chat.
bullets: Runs daily to yearly in your time zone
Pause it, edit it, or run it early
items.mediaLabel: A scheduled Polymarket probability check in Raynard

items.title: And if it’s not on the list
items.prompt: Add CoinGecko — the docs are at docs.coingecko.com
items.body: Any API with docs, including the one behind your company’s login.
bullets: Built and tested once you approve it
Keys in your keychain, chats on your machine
items.mediaLabel: Raynard creating and testing a new API extension

cards.title: API-grounded answers
cards.body: Every question is answered with a call to an API, and that response is fed into the AI.

cards.title: Direct references
cards.body: Every answer includes a reference with a direct link to the API result behind it.

cards.title: Open extensions
cards.body: Create extensions easily to talk to new APIs, whether they’re public or private.

cards.title: Powered by Pi
cards.body: Raynard is powered by Pi, the same AI agent that powers OpenClaw.
